mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenues, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in 3-year walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand surge, increasing corporate revenue visibility and reducing recession risk, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 50% of interaction-triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 over two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, increasing the likelihood of a near-term recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a stable or rising CPIAUCSL indicates a tightening monetary policy regime that suppresses inflation expectations and raises discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < -0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 470,000 million dollars combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) in the prior quarter signals strong aggregate demand, which increases corporate earnings visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% and a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150k signals a labor market tightening that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < -0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 over two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side contraction coupled with weakening labor demand, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
